# @bridge-ui/react

> React component library. Design tokens and utils come from transitive `@bridge-ui/core`.

## Setup

```bash
npm install @bridge-ui/react
npx bridge-ui-react-ai install
```

## AI + docs (this package)

- ai/AGENTS.md
- ai/llms.txt
- ai/guidelines/core.md
- ai/skills/*/SKILL.md
- docs/README.md
- docs/components/*.md

After install:

- AGENTS.md (root stub) + CLAUDE.md → AGENTS.md
- .ai/AGENTS.md (full guide)
- llms.txt
- .ai/guidelines/
- .ai/docs/ (components)
- .cursor/skills/bridge-ui-*

## Imports

- `@bridge-ui/react`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Components/{Name}`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Provider`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Actions`
- `@bridge-ui/react/theme.css`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Adapters/Examples/{date-date-fns,date-dayjs,date-luxon,date-moment}`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Adapters/Examples/{icon-lucide,icon-heroicons,icon-tabler,icon-phosphor,icon-fontawesome}`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Adapters/Examples/{i18n-dictionary,i18n-i18next}`
- `@bridge-ui/react/docs/components/{Name}.md`
